name: dye-bonemeal-crops
comment: WP-2.6. ItemDye.onItemUse and ItemDye.saddleEntity. Grass y 60 over stone; farmland with crops (stage 0) at (-4, 61, 0), an oak sapling at (4, 61, 0) and a birch one at (4, 61, 5), dirt at (-6, 60, -6). The player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, -6.5) holds 10 bone meal (dye 15, hotbar 0), 4 red dye (dye 1, hotbar 1) and 1 bone meal (hotbar 2); a white sheep (id 1). Bone meal: crops ripen (BlockCrops.fertilize, stage 7), grass at two places scatters tall grass and flowers (128 random walks from Item.itemRand, ItemDye.java:42-74), the saplings grow (BlockSapling.growTree with World.rand), dirt does nothing. Red dye on grass does nothing (only damage 15 acts). interact: red dye on the sheep dyes it red (BlockCloth.getBlockFromDye, one off the stack), red again changes nothing, bone meal dyes it white (one off). The last bone meal empties its slot.
